rules.title: HTTPS enforcement
rules.guidance: Redirect HTTP at the edge; send HSTS on HTTPS after validating subdomain readiness. HSTS alone does not secure the first visit.
rules.verification: Check HTTP redirect and HTTPS headers; reject mixed content.

rules.title: Session authentication
rules.guidance: Choose managed identity or server sessions by default where suitable. If JWTs are justified, validate signature, algorithm allowlist, issuer, audience and expiry; plan revocation.
rules.verification: Reject expired, tampered and wrong-audience credentials; verify logout semantics.

rules.title: Secure cookie sessions
rules.guidance: Use HttpOnly and Secure session cookies with narrow scope. Choose Strict or Lax from actual redirect flows; None requires Secure and explicit cross-site justification. HttpOnly does not prevent XSS actions.
rules.verification: Inspect cookies and test external sign-in, checkout return and session theft exposure.

rules.title: CSRF protection
rules.guidance: Use framework CSRF defenses on unsafe requests including PATCH; verify origin as appropriate. SameSite is defense in depth. Never mutate on GET.
rules.verification: Reject missing or invalid CSRF proof; test cross-site submissions.

rules.title: CORS policy
rules.guidance: Allow only required origins for private APIs; never reflect arbitrary origins with credentials. Public credential-free resources may use wildcard. CORS is not authorization.
rules.verification: Test allowed and hostile origins plus direct nonbrowser requests.

rules.title: SQL injection prevention
rules.guidance: Parameterize values; allowlist dynamic identifiers and sort clauses. ORMs do not protect unsafe raw SQL.
rules.verification: Test malicious values and sort keys; inspect raw query paths.

rules.title: XSS prevention
rules.guidance: Use context-aware output encoding and safe DOM APIs. Sanitize deliberately supported HTML with a maintained sanitizer; avoid blanket input mangling.
rules.verification: Exercise HTML, attribute, URL and script-context payloads.

rules.title: Rate limiting
rules.guidance: Apply endpoint, account and network limits with shared state where needed. Configure proxy trust; combine with upstream abuse defenses rather than claiming DDoS immunity.
rules.verification: Exercise bursts, multiple instances and spoofed forwarding headers.

rules.title: Password hashing
rules.guidance: Prefer Argon2id with current reviewed cost settings; use maintained libraries and unique salts. Treat bcrypt as a compatibility choice and respect byte-length limits.
rules.verification: Verify hashes differ for identical passwords and rehash migration works.

rules.title: Multi-factor authentication
rules.guidance: Offer passkeys or TOTP and protect enrollment, recovery and factor replacement. Determine assurance from the actual authentication ceremony.
rules.verification: Test recovery abuse, reused codes and stolen-session enrollment.

rules.title: Content Security Policy
rules.guidance: Deploy a policy fitted to actual resources; use nonce or hash based scripts where possible. Roll out reporting, then enforcement; avoid broad unsafe exceptions.
rules.verification: Verify violations are blocked and sign-in/payment integrations still work.

rules.title: Least privilege and authorization
rules.guidance: Deny by default; enforce object and tenant access on every request and worker task. Restrict service accounts separately from end-user permissions.
rules.verification: Attempt cross-user and cross-tenant reads and writes including exports.

rules.title: Encryption at rest
rules.guidance: Classify data; use managed storage encryption and additional field encryption where threat model warrants. Use authenticated encryption and managed key rotation, not hand-built crypto.
rules.verification: Test key access boundaries, rotation and recovery without exposing plaintext.

rules.title: Transport encryption
rules.guidance: Prefer TLS 1.3 and retain securely configured TLS 1.2 only when required. Validate certificates; consider service identity and mTLS across trust boundaries.
rules.verification: Reject invalid certificates and obsolete protocols; inspect internal hops.

rules.title: Privacy obligations
rules.guidance: Map data, purposes, retention and applicable obligations; implement deletion/export and consent controls where required. A banner alone is not compliance.
rules.verification: Trace a deletion through replicas and processors; verify optional collection choices.

rules.title: Payment compliance scope
rules.guidance: Use hosted payment collection; keep card numbers and security codes out of app servers and logs. Confirm actual obligations with the provider and qualified reviewers.
rules.verification: Inspect traffic/logs for card data and document integration scope.

rules.title: Boundary input validation
rules.guidance: Validate schemas, sizes and semantics at server trust boundaries, including worker inputs. Authorize fields to prevent mass assignment; client types are insufficient.
rules.verification: Reject oversized, unknown privileged and malformed fields.

rules.title: Safe errors and logs
rules.guidance: Return generic client errors plus correlation IDs; keep restricted diagnostic logs with redaction, retention and access controls. Do not log secrets or unnecessary PII.
rules.verification: Trigger failures and inspect both client output and stored logs.

rules.title: Secret management and rotation
rules.guidance: Keep secrets in managed stores, never bundles or git. Prefer short-lived credentials; rotate with overlap, revocation and rollback procedures.
rules.verification: Rotate a test secret and verify old credentials cease working.

rules.title: Security response headers
rules.guidance: Set nosniff and appropriate referrer policy. Use CSP frame-ancestors; apply X-Frame-Options when compatible with intentional embedding.
rules.verification: Check actual edge responses and legitimate embed behavior.

rules.title: Tokenized payment collection
rules.guidance: Collect payment details with provider-hosted fields or checkout; create payment amounts and order identifiers on the server.
rules.verification: Tamper with client totals and confirm server pricing prevails.

rules.title: Idempotent payment webhooks
rules.guidance: Verify signatures on raw bytes using the provider SDK, durably record events, and make business effects idempotent. Handle retries and out-of-order delivery.
rules.verification: Replay events, deliver concurrently/out of order, and crash between persistence and processing.

rules.title: Atomic inventory reservations
rules.guidance: Reserve stock using conditional writes or transactions; expire abandoned reservations. Do not hold DB locks while waiting for payment network calls.
rules.verification: Race buyers for the last unit and test expiry/payment arrival races.

rules.title: Multi-currency pricing
rules.guidance: Store explicit currency and integer minor units or suitable decimals; respect zero/three-decimal currencies. Confirm currency before purchase; locale is only a hint.
rules.verification: Test rounding, currency changes, refunds and server/provider amount equality.

rules.title: Guest checkout
rules.guidance: Allow guest purchase where business rules permit; provide secure order access and optional account linking without exposing orders by email alone.
rules.verification: Buy as a guest and attempt unauthorized order lookup.

rules.title: Optimistic cart updates
rules.guidance: Update provisionally with rollback and server reconciliation; communicate rejected stock/price changes. Do not present payment as successful optimistically.
rules.verification: Simulate failure, slow responses and edits arriving out of order.

rules.title: Persistent cart
rules.guidance: Persist nonsensitive cart identifiers/items; reconcile server prices, quantities and ownership after sign-in. Avoid storing session credentials in localStorage.
rules.verification: Merge guest/account carts and verify account switching cannot leak items.

rules.title: Address assistance
rules.guidance: Provide optional address suggestions and manual entry; validate shipping eligibility server-side and minimize data sent to vendors.
rules.verification: Test unsupported addresses, keyboard access and vendor failure.

rules.title: Tax calculation
rules.guidance: Determine obligations and configured jurisdictions with appropriate expertise; compute tax server-side using current provider rules and retain calculation evidence.
rules.verification: Test inclusive/exclusive tax, discounts and refund adjustments in sandbox.

rules.title: Refund reconciliation
rules.guidance: Model refunds as asynchronous states; use idempotency and reconcile provider results to the ledger. Never promise immediate bank settlement.
rules.verification: Test duplicate requests, partial refunds, provider failure and delayed completion.

rules.title: 3DS and payment challenges
rules.guidance: Use provider-supported challenge flows; handle pending, failed, canceled and resumed attempts. Confirm success server-side.
rules.verification: Exercise sandbox challenge, cancel, retry and asynchronous completion.

rules.title: Cart recovery messages
rules.guidance: Use lawful eligibility, consent/preferences where required, suppression lists and frequency limits; distinguish marketing from transactional messages.
rules.verification: Confirm opted-out and completed buyers receive no recovery campaign.

rules.title: Server-side discounts
rules.guidance: Enforce eligibility, expiry, stacking and redemption limits atomically; recalculate totals on the server.
rules.verification: Race limited coupons and tamper with discount amounts and account identity.

rules.title: Server-side rendering
rules.guidance: Choose SSR per route based on content and latency; avoid caching private output across users and unnecessary server work.
rules.verification: Measure initial response and test personalized cache isolation.

rules.title: Static generation
rules.guidance: Prebuild suitable content and define refresh/invalidation; keep private or rapidly changing values authoritative at runtime.
rules.verification: Change content/prices and verify freshness and preview behavior.

rules.title: CDN distribution
rules.guidance: Cache public resources with explicit keys and invalidation. Keep credentials and private responses out of shared caches.
rules.verification: Compare authenticated users and verify cache purge/version behavior.

rules.title: Database indexes
rules.guidance: Use query plans and representative data to add targeted indexes; consider write cost, locking and migration safety.
rules.verification: Compare query plans, latency and write throughput before/after.

rules.title: Connection pooling
rules.guidance: Budget connections across instances and workers; use a pool compatible with deployment and transaction semantics.
rules.verification: Load-test peak concurrency and verify bounded connection counts/timeouts.

rules.title: Caching
rules.guidance: Choose cache only with clear invalidation and ownership keys; bound TTL and memory, prevent stampedes, and handle cache outage.
rules.verification: Test stale values, tenant isolation and cache loss.

rules.title: Lazy loading
rules.guidance: Defer below-fold images and optional code; do not lazy-load primary above-fold content. Preserve accessibility and dimensions.
rules.verification: Measure initial requests and verify deferred content loads on interaction.

rules.title: Asset compression
rules.guidance: Use appropriate modern image formats with fallbacks and Brotli/gzip for text; preserve visual quality and avoid compressing already-compressed data unnecessarily.
rules.verification: Inspect negotiated formats, response sizes and readable fallback output.

rules.title: API pagination
rules.guidance: Set hard size limits and stable ordering; use opaque cursors where appropriate and authorize every page.
rules.verification: Test ties, concurrent inserts, bad cursors and maximum page limits.

rules.title: Background queues
rules.guidance: Persist jobs reliably, define retry/backoff, idempotency and dead-letter handling; use an outbox when DB changes must cause jobs.
rules.verification: Crash workers, replay jobs and observe backlog/poison-message handling.

rules.title: Micro-frontends
rules.guidance: Default to a simpler modular application; adopt micro-frontends only with explicit ownership and deployment benefits that justify integration cost.
rules.verification: Document the tradeoff and test shared auth, routing and version skew.

rules.title: Load balancing
rules.guidance: Use health/readiness checks and connection draining; design routing around long-lived connections and regional constraints.
rules.verification: Remove an instance under traffic and verify safe rerouting.

rules.title: Stateless app servers
rules.guidance: Move durable state to suitable stores; handle websocket/session affinity explicitly when needed. Do not mistake stateless servers for a stateless system.
rules.verification: Restart instances mid-flow and verify no durable state loss.

rules.title: Responsive design
rules.guidance: Design small-screen layouts, touch targets, safe areas and zoom behavior; use content-driven breakpoints.
rules.verification: Test narrow/wide layouts, zoom, orientation and long content.

rules.title: Accessibility target
rules.guidance: Target WCAG 2.2 AA for web unless requirements specify otherwise. Use semantic controls, labels and accessible errors; do not claim conformance from an automated scan.
rules.verification: Combine automated checks with keyboard, screen reader and contrast review.

rules.title: Keyboard and focus
rules.guidance: Use predictable focus order, visible focus, modal containment/return and escape behavior. Prefer native controls over custom ARIA widgets.
rules.verification: Complete key flows without a pointer and check no unintended traps.

rules.title: Loading states
rules.guidance: Use appropriate skeletons or progress messages without flicker; announce meaningful changes and respect reduced motion.
rules.verification: Test slow/offline transitions and screen reader announcements.

rules.title: Layout stability
rules.guidance: Reserve image/embed dimensions and account for font swaps and inserted banners.
rules.verification: Measure CLS under slow fonts/images and consent/loading transitions.

rules.title: Form autocomplete
rules.guidance: Use standard input types and autocomplete tokens on appropriate fields; keep payment card fields within provider-hosted integrations.
rules.verification: Test browser autofill, password managers and mobile keyboards.

rules.title: Inline validation
rules.guidance: Validate helpfully without interrupting typing; retain values and connect errors to labels. Repeat validation on the server.
rules.verification: Submit invalid forms by keyboard and verify readable recoverable errors.

rules.title: Theme preferences
rules.guidance: Respect system preference and explicit user choice; ensure contrast in every theme and avoid initial theme flash.
rules.verification: Test theme persistence, system changes and contrast.

rules.title: Optimistic mutations
rules.guidance: Use pending state, cancellation/rollback and response ordering. Require authoritative confirmation for destructive or financial outcomes.
rules.verification: Test failed and reordered operations and concurrent edits.

rules.title: Collection navigation
rules.guidance: Choose pagination/load-more/infinite scrolling based on task; preserve position and access to footer and navigation.
rules.verification: Test back navigation, keyboard traversal and refresh/bookmarks.

rules.title: Notifications in UI
rules.guidance: Use accessible status messages with sufficient display time; keep essential errors/actionable details persistent instead of toast-only.
rules.verification: Test screen reader announcements and recovery after a toast disappears.

rules.title: Browser compatibility
rules.guidance: Define a support matrix and test Chromium, WebKit and Gecko as relevant; use feature detection and progressive enhancement.
rules.verification: Run critical flows on supported engines and representative devices.

rules.title: Empty states
rules.guidance: Distinguish first use, no match, permissions, loading and failure; offer the appropriate next action.
rules.verification: Exercise each state without suggesting unauthorized actions.

rules.title: Faceted search
rules.guidance: Use validated filters reflected in URLs; authorize query results and counts; provide reset controls.
rules.verification: Test filter combinations, zero results and private item leakage.

rules.title: Fuzzy matching
rules.guidance: Tune matching to the domain and language, enforce access filters and bound query expense.
rules.verification: Evaluate typos, exact identifiers, relevance and sensitive results.

rules.title: Sitemaps
rules.guidance: List canonical indexable URLs; regenerate on meaningful change rather than requiring daily runs. Exclude private and redirect/error pages.
rules.verification: Parse generated XML and check representative URL status/indexability.

rules.title: Semantic HTML
rules.guidance: Use appropriate landmarks, heading order and native interactive elements; avoid redundant ARIA.
rules.verification: Inspect document structure and screen reader navigation.

rules.title: Structured data
rules.guidance: Use supported JSON-LD types with truthful visible content; never fabricate ratings or promise rich results.
rules.verification: Validate structured data and compare values with page content.

rules.title: Canonical URLs
rules.guidance: Set consistent canonical targets and coherent redirects/sitemaps; canonical is a hint, not access control.
rules.verification: Compare variant URLs and confirm intended canonical is indexable.

rules.title: Readable URLs
rules.guidance: Use stable meaningful slugs, support necessary Unicode and redirect changed paths; avoid sensitive identifiers in URLs.
rules.verification: Test collisions, renamed records, encoding and old links.

rules.title: Typeahead
rules.guidance: Debounce and cancel stale queries; implement accessible combobox behavior and do not expose private search history.
rules.verification: Test rapid input, response reorder, keyboard selection and privacy.

rules.title: Server-rendered metadata
rules.guidance: Deliver title/description/Open Graph metadata in initial HTML where crawlers need it; use absolute image URLs and avoid leaking private content.
rules.verification: Fetch HTML without scripts and test image accessibility.

rules.title: CI/CD checks
rules.guidance: Run builds, lint, tests and security checks on PRs with minimal permissions. Protect release paths and never expose secrets to untrusted contributions.
rules.verification: Verify a failing change blocks the configured merge/release path.

rules.title: Blue-green deployment
rules.guidance: Use only when hosting and data compatibility support it; migrate using expand/contract patterns and keep rollback credible.
rules.verification: Rehearse switch/rollback with old and new versions against the same schema.

rules.title: Canary releases
rules.guidance: Choose cohort and ramp from risk, not a universal five percent; define metrics, abort thresholds and rollback ownership.
rules.verification: Inject an error and demonstrate rollout halt and recovery.

rules.title: Centralized logs
rules.guidance: Collect structured redacted logs with correlation IDs, access control, retention and actionable alerts.
rules.verification: Trace one failed flow across components without exposing secrets.

rules.title: Synthetic monitoring
rules.guidance: Use isolated test identities/data and safe sandbox payment flows; alert on actionable availability and latency failures.
rules.verification: Break a dependency and verify alert routing and cleanup.

rules.title: Graceful shutdown
rules.guidance: Stop accepting new work, drain requests, acknowledge jobs only after durable completion and bound termination time.
rules.verification: Terminate during requests/jobs and verify safe retry behavior.

rules.title: Backups and recovery
rules.guidance: Choose RPO/RTO, backup frequency and point-in-time logging accordingly. Encrypt backups and regularly restore to an isolated environment.
rules.verification: Restore to a chosen time and measure actual data loss and recovery duration.

rules.title: Multi-region recovery
rules.guidance: Define replication consistency, failover authority, residency constraints and split-brain prevention. Simpler tested backups may fit smaller systems.
rules.verification: Rehearse failover/failback and reconciliation under a documented scenario.

rules.title: Circuit breakers
rules.guidance: Set timeouts, bounded retries with jitter and safe fallbacks; use circuit breakers when they improve failure isolation.
rules.verification: Simulate latency/errors and ensure requests and retries remain bounded.

rules.title: Reproducible runtime
rules.guidance: Use lockfiles and reproducible builds; containers are optional. If used, run minimal nonroot images, scan them and keep secrets out of layers.
rules.verification: Build cleanly and run under intended permissions/runtime constraints.

rules.title: Client analytics
rules.guidance: Collect minimal events with documented retention and appropriate user choices; avoid raw input capture and unnecessary identifiers.
rules.verification: Inspect event payloads and verify collection follows preferences.

rules.title: Feature flags
rules.guidance: Evaluate access-sensitive logic server-side; assign owners, expiry and fallback. Flags are not authorization.
rules.verification: Test missing flag service, both branches and eventual removal.

rules.title: A/B experiments
rules.guidance: Define outcome, sample strategy and guardrails before launch; assign stable cohorts and respect data choices.
rules.verification: Check allocation, contamination and stopping criteria.

rules.title: Server-side analytics
rules.guidance: Preserve consent/opt-outs and minimize payloads; never use server tracking to defeat expressed privacy choices. Deduplicate browser/server events.
rules.verification: Verify opted-out events stay suppressed and duplicate conversions collapse.

rules.title: Idempotent data synchronization
rules.guidance: Use stable source keys, unique constraints, checkpoints and explicit conflict policy; handle deletions as well as inserts.
rules.verification: Replay imports and interrupt/restart midway without duplicate rows.

rules.title: Analytics data minimization
rules.guidance: Remove or aggregate unnecessary data before collection; pseudonymization is not anonymization. Limit join keys and access.
rules.verification: Inspect exported data and attempt unauthorized reidentification joins.

rules.title: Identity merging
rules.guidance: Merge only with verified identity and allowed purpose; maintain logout boundaries and avoid merging shared-device users incorrectly.
rules.verification: Test account switching, shared devices and deletion propagation.

rules.title: Transactional email
rules.guidance: Use a reliable provider, durable enqueue, idempotency and bounce handling; configure sender authentication and separate marketing preferences.
rules.verification: Retry jobs and test bounces without duplicate sensitive notices.

rules.title: SMS alerts
rules.guidance: Respect channel permissions and relevant rules; validate provider webhooks, prevent abuse and avoid sensitive lock-screen content.
rules.verification: Test opt-out, invalid signatures, retries and spend limits.

rules.title: Push notifications
rules.guidance: Bind tokens to the correct account/device, revoke on logout and clean invalid tokens; minimize visible sensitive data.
rules.verification: Switch accounts on one device and verify old-account pushes stop.

rules.title: Magic sign-in links
rules.guidance: Use high-entropy, short-lived single-use tokens stored hashed; rate-limit requests and restrict redirects. Avoid consuming credentials on email-scanner GET requests.
rules.verification: Test replay, expiry, link scanners, redirect tampering and account enumeration.

rules.title: In-app inbox
rules.guidance: Authorize per-user messages, paginate and synchronize read state; localize content and retain only as needed.
rules.verification: Try another user's message ID and concurrent read updates.

rules.title: Locale routing
rules.guidance: Choose stable locale rules, explicit user override and consistent fallback; connect localized equivalents appropriately.
rules.verification: Test unknown locales, direct links and preference changes.

rules.title: Dates, times and numbers
rules.guidance: Store instants with timezone context as needed; use locale formatting and explicit display zones. Preserve date-only and scheduled-local-time semantics.
rules.verification: Test DST gaps/overlaps, date boundaries and decimal separators.

rules.title: RTL layouts
rules.guidance: Use logical CSS properties and explicit bidirectional handling; mirror directional affordances selectively.
rules.verification: Test real RTL text, mixed identifiers and keyboard order.

rules.title: Linting and formatting
rules.guidance: Adopt stack-appropriate lint/format rules in CI; local hooks are convenience rather than the enforcement boundary.
rules.verification: Submit a deliberate violation and verify CI reports it.

rules.title: Unit testing
rules.guidance: Prioritize meaningful boundary/error tests and critical math; avoid coverage targets that reward implementation-mirroring tests.
rules.verification: Demonstrate representative logic faults fail tests.

rules.title: End-to-end testing
rules.guidance: Test meaningful behavior and recovery using isolated data; include accessibility and real supported browsers where feasible.
rules.verification: Run success and failure paths without dependence on production credentials.

rules.title: Interface contracts
rules.guidance: Use versioned runtime schemas and generated types where helpful; type safety alone does not validate hostile input.
rules.verification: Test incompatible payloads and backward compatibility of deployed clients.

rules.title: Development parity
rules.guidance: Match relevant versions/configuration shape using synthetic data; never copy production secrets or personal data into local development.
rules.verification: Start from documented setup and compare required config keys.

rules.title: Dependency security
rules.guidance: Use lockfiles, automated vulnerability and secret scanning, update policy and reviewed advisories; triage exploitability and document time-bounded exceptions.
rules.verification: Introduce a test finding and verify triage/remediation workflow.

rules.title: Readable maintainable code
rules.guidance: Use domain names, small cohesive modules and explanations for nonobvious decisions; document operations and public interfaces where names alone are insufficient.
rules.verification: Have a reviewer trace a core workflow and locate its failure/recovery paths.
